other_conditions: Girl child must be born in a government hospital or government‑recognised private hospital in Arunachal Pradesh.
Father/guardian must belong to a Scheduled Tribe of Arunachal Pradesh, be a domicile resident of Arunachal Pradesh, or possess a household residential certificate.
Scheme is limited to the first two live girl children.
For maturity claim, the beneficiary must be at least 18 years old and have passed the class‑X examination.
benefits_summary: A fixed deposit of ₹20,000 is opened for the girl child, which can be withdrawn at age 18 after verification.
